# RKAZN

> AI and product development studio founded by Rudra Kapadia. RKAZN helps
> businesses turn repetitive manual work, scattered data, and ambitious
> product ideas into intelligent, custom-built systems — AI automation, AI
> agents, and full-stack AI products designed around how the business
> already works, rather than forcing a switch to new platforms.

## Services

- [AI Automation Services](https://rkazn.com/services/ai-automation): End-to-end AI-driven automation of manual business workflows.
- [Custom AI Solutions](https://rkazn.com/services/custom-ai-solutions): Bespoke AI systems built for use cases off-the-shelf tools don't cover.
- [AI Agent Development](https://rkazn.com/services/ai-agent-development): Autonomous AI agents that handle multi-step business tasks.
- [AI Workflow Automation](https://rkazn.com/services/ai-workflow-automation): Automating specific, defined workflows end to end.
- [Business Process Automation](https://rkazn.com/services/business-process-automation): Mapping and automating business processes without breaking edge cases.

## Free tools

- [Automation ROI Calculator](https://rkazn.com/tools/roi-calculator): Estimates the real cost/benefit of automating a manual process.
